notes.title: Update Notes For July 24th
notes.content:
I did some small fixes!


 The game now saves after a completed challenge. Hopefully this solves an issue where all progress was lost on a restart of the game.
 Tweaked the "Are We There Yet?" achievement to make it less grindy.

notes.title: Autogame Deluxe is releasing July 21st!
notes.content:
Autogame Deluxe will release on July 21st!
To celebrate the upcoming release, Autogame will be taking part in this week's Steam Next Fest!



The full game will include:

Local multiplayer with up to 10 players

Support for any keyboard or controller you can think of, including sharing a controller

Bots to fill up any empty driver seat (optional)

Adjustable settings for more replayability and chaos!

20 single player challenges with weird twists (drive 88 mph, in the dark, or... eat cars?)

Some unlockable twists that can be added to your multiplayer games!



I'm also happy to share that the game will be available in 10 languages:

English

German

Spanish

French

Italian

Portugese (Brazilian)

Korean

Chinese

Japanese

Arabic


Wishlist, go play the demo, and let me know what you think on the Steam forum or Discord!
As always: the game (and demo!) is best local multiplayer but do try it with your online friends as well using Remote Play Together! You still only need one copy to play!

notes.title: Autogame Deluxe Demo
notes.content:
The demo for Autogame Deluxe is live! Get a taste of the chaos with 1-4 players or try out the first 5 special single player challenges! Not in one room together? No problem, try Steam Remote Play Together!

The demo features:

 Up to 4 players. The full game will allow for 10 simultaneous players
 Play with keyboard, as well as gamepads
 The single screen gameplay is ideal for Steam's Remote Play Together
 5 single player challenges with special rules. The full game will have 20 for you!
